title: The Deep Hollow
content: Below the ash, past where the light gives up, the Deep Hollow keeps the richest resonant ore and the oldest wrecks.
It also keeps you. Unprotected travelers weaken within minutes — a dimensional exposure your body reads as exhaustion. The ward holds it back. So does leaving.
The stalkers hunt here in packs and the fractures cluster thick. Bring a scanner, a ward, and a way home.
What is buried deepest has not been cataloged. The Codex waits.
